about: What each verb and feature needs to run: the tools Cut uses and the conditions of this machine and project. One source for the engine (system.doctor requirements, the refusals) and the agent and person documents. An open project is not listed per feature: it follows each verb's behavior.project_state in schema/verbs.json. Every verb must be in exactly one feature (requires: [] declares that it needs nothing); scripts/public-tests/requirements-contract.test.mjs and the engine's requirements tests check it. The tables in skill/shellx-cut/SKILL.md and reference.md are generated from this file: node scripts/generate-requirements-docs.mjs (--check in CI).

requirements.name: Video processing (FFmpeg)
requirements.what: Reads, previews, converts and exports video and audio.

get.person: before downloading, tell the person it is FFmpeg under the GNU General Public License version 3 (the consent text in system.doctor's ffmpeg card names publisher, version and size) and ask whether you may download it and accept that licence; if the person asked for the download themselves, that is the go-ahead, and your reply says which licence applied. In the app the person chooses Download or Choose ffmpeg; an ffmpeg they already have works through system.set_ffmpeg {path}

requirements.name: Media inspection (ffprobe)
requirements.what: Reads the length, size and streams of a media file; comes with FFmpeg.

get.person: comes with FFmpeg: the same download, licence and question as FFmpeg

requirements.name: Stabilization in FFmpeg (vid.stab)
requirements.what: The FFmpeg filters Stabilize uses.

get.person: a complete FFmpeg build is needed (on a Mac: Homebrew's ffmpeg-full); the steps are in system.doctor's ffmpeg card, details.setup

requirements.name: Caption burn-in in FFmpeg (libass)
requirements.what: The FFmpeg filter that draws captions into an export.

get.person: a complete FFmpeg build is needed; the steps are in system.doctor's ffmpeg card, details.setup

requirements.name: Color management in FFmpeg (zimg)
requirements.what: The FFmpeg filter for color-managed export and the HDR tone map.

get.person: a complete FFmpeg build is needed; the steps are in system.doctor's ffmpeg card, details.setup

requirements.name: Faster exports (GPU encoder)
requirements.what: A hardware video encoder (NVENC, Quick Sync, AMF or VideoToolbox) in the FFmpeg Cut uses.

get.person: needs a supported graphics card, its driver and an FFmpeg built with its encoder; the steps are in system.doctor's gpu-encode card, details.enable_help

requirements.name: GPU render path (CUDA)
requirements.what: The opt-in path that also scales and composites on an NVIDIA GPU.

get.person: needs an NVIDIA GPU with its driver and an FFmpeg with CUDA filters

requirements.name: Captions and transcription
requirements.what: Cut's own Python environment for transcription, silences, scenes, beats, faces and the output checks.

get.person: a download of several hundred MB that needs no Python of the person's own. On macOS and Linux it needs no administrator permission; on Windows Microsoft's Visual C++ runtime must be installed first (its own Install in the same Settings page), and Windows asks for administrator permission for that step

requirements.name: Speech-to-text model
requirements.what: The transcription model inside the captions runtime.

get.person: comes with Install captions; system.set_stt_model chooses the model

requirements.name: Microsoft Visual C++ Redistributable
requirements.what: Windows runtime files the captions runtime's native modules load.

license.name: Microsoft Software License Terms for the Microsoft Visual C++ Redistributable

get.person: Microsoft's own installer from Microsoft (aka.ms/vc14), checked for Microsoft's signature; Windows asks a person for administrator permission, which an agent cannot give; or install it from https://learn.microsoft.com/cpp/windows/latest-supported-vc-redist

requirements.name: Background removal
requirements.what: The local cutout model and runtime Remove background uses.

requirements.name: Premium background removal
requirements.what: The higher-quality cutout install (NVIDIA GPU).

get.person: the premium model is licensed for non-commercial use only (NTU S-Lab License 1.0): tell the person and ask before installing; accept_noncommercial:true states their yes. It needs an NVIDIA GPU; about 3 GB

requirements.name: Render review (a signed-in agent CLI)
requirements.what: Claude Code, Codex or another agent CLI the person has installed and signed in to; Cut drives it to review renders.

get.person: the person installs the CLI and signs in to it themselves; Cut never signs in for anyone. Then Re-scan (system.doctor {refresh:true})

requirements.name: Agent CLI for chat and translation
requirements.what: A signed-in Claude Code, Codex, Grok or Antigravity CLI that Agent Chat and translation run on.

get.person: the person installs the CLI and signs in to it themselves; Cut never signs in for anyone. Then Re-scan (system.doctor {refresh:true})

requirements.name: Media generation provider
requirements.what: A signed-in generation CLI (Codex image generation, Grok Imagine, Antigravity) for generated media and Generate plans.

state.reason: not checked by system.doctor; assets.providers reports each provider's readiness

get.person: the person installs the provider's CLI and signs in themselves; Cut never signs in for anyone

requirements.name: Dubbing service
requirements.what: The local text-to-speech service audio.dub uses.

get.person: start the dubbing service and set its address (CUT_DUB_ENDPOINT); see system.doctor's dub card

requirements.name: Speaker labelling service
requirements.what: The local diarization service media.diarize uses.

get.person: start the speaker labelling service and set its address (CUT_DIARIZE_ENDPOINT); see system.doctor's diarize card

requirements.name: ShellX Motion
requirements.what: The separate ShellX Motion app that renders motion templates and tracking for Cut.

state.reason: not checked by system.doctor; system.motion_status reports it

get.person: ShellX Motion is installed separately

requirements.name: An open project
requirements.what: A project is open in this engine.

get.person: open or create a project (project.open {path} or project.create {name})

requirements.name: A usable export folder
requirements.what: The chosen export folder exists and accepts files (or the project's exports folder is used).

get.person: choose another export folder, or clear the choice to use the project's exports folder

requirements.name: Free disk space
requirements.what: Room on the app-data drive for downloads and on the export drive for renders.

get.person: free space on the drive; Settings > Health & recovery can preview and remove Cut's aged cache files (Preview cache cleanup)

requirements.name: A transcript of the asset
requirements.what: The asset has been transcribed.

get.person: a transcript is made after a clip is imported while Captions and transcription is installed. For a clip imported before that, a person can run a recipe that starts with a transcript (Recipes > Add captions, which also adds captions); there is no separate Transcribe button

requirements.name: An analysis of the asset
requirements.what: The asset's silences, scenes, beats and loudness have been measured (done after import when captions are installed).

get.person: silences, scenes, beats and loudness are measured after a clip is imported while Captions and transcription is installed. For a clip imported before that, the recipes First edit and Edit for clarity measure it; there is no separate button

requirements.name: Screen recording permission
requirements.what: The operating system lets ShellX Cut capture the screen.

state.reason: read by screen_record.doctor {mode:'status'} (screen_check), not by system.doctor

get.person: a person must allow it: macOS System Settings > Privacy & Security > Screen & System Audio Recording, then reopen ShellX Cut; on Linux the screen-sharing portal asks

requirements.name: Microphone access
requirements.what: The operating system lets ShellX Cut use the microphone, and a microphone is present.

state.reason: read by screen_record.doctor {mode:'microphone'} (microphone_blocked), not by system.doctor

get.person: a person must allow it in the system's privacy settings (Windows: Settings > Privacy & security > Microphone; macOS: Privacy & Security > Microphone)

requirements.name: System sound capture
requirements.what: The operating system lets ShellX Cut record the computer's own sound.

state.reason: read by screen_record.system_audio_probe, not by system.doctor

get.person: a person must allow it (macOS asks separately for Audio Capture)

requirements.name: The editor window
requirements.what: A ShellX Cut window (or the app in a browser) is connected to this engine.

get.person: open the app; system.doctor gives the local address to open in a browser

requirements.name: Internet connection
requirements.what: Downloads and online stock search need the internet.

state.not_checked: Cut does not probe the network; a download or search that cannot connect says so

get.person: connect to the internet and retry

features.name: Project, sequences, history and timeline edits
features.note: These verbs change or read the project; what they record is drawn by preview and export, which have their own needs. recipe.run and plugins.call need what the verbs they run need.

optional.effect: the setting is kept, but a color-managed export is refused until the FFmpeg Cut uses has zimg
imports are not analysed: no silences, scenes, beats or transcript until captions are installed and the asset is analysed

features.name: Edits from the analysis (scenes, beats, silences, emphasis, speaker energy)
features.note: The analysis is made by media.perception (or after import when captions are installed). audio.add_music ducks under speech from the base track's analysis.

features.name: Word edits, transcript search, chapters and generated captions
features.note: Without a transcript these verbs refuse with the reason: captions not installed (Install captions) or the asset not transcribed (media.transcribe).

features.name: Translation of captions and transcripts
features.note: First choice: the person's signed-in agent CLI; otherwise the local translation model in the captions runtime. transcript.translate also needs the asset's transcript.

features.name: Dubbing
features.note: Translation runs on the person's signed-in agent CLI first, otherwise on the local model; the speech is made by the dubbing service through the captions runtime's bridge.

features.name: Motion tracking and the visual search index
Redaction (blur or cover a region, faces, text)

optional.effect: faces and automatic text detection need it; a drawn region works without it

features.name: Visual search

optional.effect: a text query needs it to become a search vector; query_vector works without it
the search model is downloaded the first time a text query runs

features.note: Searches the visual index media.index built.

optional.effect: without it the standard cutout model is used

features.name: Color match, auto balance and multicam audio sync
features.note: These read frames or audio of the clips to compute the edit.

features.name: Titles, shapes and Generate templates on the timeline

optional.effect: without a provider, generate.from_prompt and generate.storyboard plan only from the built-in templates (status not_run for what needs a provider)
generate.from_prompt and generate.storyboard with policy insert make media and need FFmpeg; the default plan does not

features.name: Preview frames, comparisons, storyboards and scopes

optional.effect: a project with HDR clips needs zimg for the tone map; without it these verbs refuse and name the clips
without a GPU encoder the export uses the software encoder (slower, same picture)
without it the GPU render path is not available; the software path renders the same frames
captions cannot be burned into the export; the export is refused while burned captions are asked for
a color-managed or HDR export is refused until FFmpeg has zimg
the output checks are not measured; the receipt says 'not measured' with the reason
the render plan warns or refuses when the export drive is too full

features.name: Output checks
features.note: verify.checks reads the last render receipt; verify.pacing, verify.captions and verify.pregate read the project and its analysis.

features.name: Stock media and b-roll
features.note: Online providers need the internet; the local_folder provider does not.

features.name: ShellX Motion templates and tracking
features.note: motion.map_import and motion.apply_import read a package ShellX Motion already wrote.

optional.effect: the recording has no microphone sound
the recording has no system sound
